sharedEditsNeeded: Stream copy from iff: native keeps iff_read_header's block_align = channels * bits (bits, not bytes), which WAV/W64 (nBlockAlign), AIFF (numSampleFrames = payload / block_align) and CAF (mBytesPerPacket) write; the PCM path needs a native copy block_align on the stream info, or a per-muxer copy refusal, before iff -c copy into those muxers can match or be refused (copyRefusal would also refuse the matching framecrc/raw copies).
notes: Probe precedence 26: the FORM head overlaps aiff (30); the confirm reads 12 bytes and requires MAUD at byte 8, resolving false without reading on shorter input, so AIFF/AIFC and a bare 4-byte FORM keep detecting as aiff (unit-tested; container-registry tests unchanged and passing). Disjoint from nsp's DS16 check at 24.
Native exit statuses 176 (AVERROR_PATCHWELCOME) and 183 (AVERROR_INVALIDDATA) are FFERRTAG values, not errno based, so no host errno mapping was needed.
The sandbox Node was 22.23.5; tests and bootstrap ran with the preinstalled Node 24.22.3 (/opt/node24).

Setup durations: bootstrap 232 s (npm 10.5 s, submodule 7.9 s, reference build about 213 s); baseline typecheck+lint+boundaries plus registry tests 78 s (all passing); the first bootstrap attempt failed immediately under Node 22.
Evidence is from the sandbox linux-x64 reference build, not the pinned binary; a branch is not compatibility evidence until linux-probe and macOS validation pass.

Audit (audit-fmt-b): mono/stereo inputs now report masks 0x4/0x3 as native's explicit MONO/STEREO layouts (they diverged under -guess_layout_max 0/1), and the probe no longer claims a FORM DS16 MAUD head, which native leaves undetected because nsp_probe ties at 100. Still open: -c copy into WAV, W64 and AIFF exits 0 with headers that differ from native (block_align = channels * bits); see sharedEditsNeeded. The audit test ran on macOS arm64 against the pinned darwin reference (sha256 1b86106f…ab92, Apple clang 21.0.0), not on the sandbox linux-x64 build; its linux-x64 evidence comes from CI.
